title: qwq-official
description: qwq is a community driven mod that's, well, made by the community!
body:
qwq is a community driven mod solely focused on being a community remix of minecraft! The mod currently adds:
- 1 Damage Type
- 11 Items
- 1 Plant
- 2 Status Effects
- Recipes for ~~most~~ all items, or some way to obtain them
- 12 Structures
- 24 Weapons
- 1 Mob

And we're working on adding more!
If you'd like to add your own items, go to the [Discord](https://discord.gg/bCctGdzRb9) and go to the "qwq-mod-additions" to add your own item as long as the item is appropriate and the item has some sort of sprite that you have made. Plagiarism will not be allowed. Thank you for playing this mod!
